verdict.rationale: Ironclad's own product page promises secure contract storage with easy findability ("Store Contracts Securely, Find Them Easily"), and its Records API retrieves, creates and updates structured contract records, which together point to a searchable repository with metadata. Automatic extraction of key terms and metadata from executed contracts is not explicitly documented; the AI pages are only taglines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI or automated key-term and metadata extraction, detail on repository search capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of repository use.
